name: PS Rent Schedule Writeback
PS Rent Schedule Payment Sync
PS Rent Schedule Release On Cancel
script:
# Powersoft Property - releases the rent schedule period when an invoice is
# cancelled, so the period can be re-invoiced instead of being locked forever.

lease_name = doc.get('ps_lease_agreement')

if lease_name:
    lease = frappe.get_doc('PS Lease Agreement', lease_name)
    today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())

    for r in lease.rent_schedule:
        if r.sales_invoice == doc.name:
            status = 'Not Invoiced'
            if r.due_date and frappe.utils.getdate(r.due_date) < today:
                status = 'Overdue'
            r.db_set('sales_invoice', None, update_modified=False)
            r.db_set('invoice_status', status, update_modified=False)
            r.db_set('amount_paid', 0, update_modified=False)
            r.db_set('balance', frappe.utils.flt(r.total_due), update_modified=False)
            r.db_set('paid_on', None, update_modified=False)
            break

    lease.reload()
    billed = ('Invoiced', 'Partly Paid', 'Paid', 'Overdue')
    inv = 0.0
    paid = 0.0
    for r in lease.rent_schedule:
        if r.sales_invoice or r.invoice_status in billed:
            inv = inv + frappe.utils.flt(r.total_due)
        paid = paid + frappe.utils.flt(r.amount_paid)
    bal = inv - paid
    if bal < 0:
        bal = 0.0

    frappe.db.set_value('PS Lease Agreement', lease_name, {'total_invoiced': inv, 'total_paid': paid, 'outstanding_balance': bal}, update_modified=False)
